messages:
morgan: Quick heads-up — I'm opening a small PR to run the docs voice/terminology linter and patch a batch of broken internal links. Goal: reduce noisy style comments in upcoming doc sweep.
anya: Love it. Is this the same lint config we used for the SDK guides?
morgan: It's based on that but with a few tweaks — stricter on model naming (no 'redwood' lowercase), prefer 'Dedicated' vs 'dedicated' in product pages, and normalize 'LLM' capitalization. Also a rule to prefer 'rollout' over 'canary' in our customer-facing docs.
sam: Can the linter auto-fix link redirects (docs moved during navbar reorg)? Last time I had to manually update a dozen anchors.
morgan: It will follow HTTP 3xx redirects for internal links and replace them with the final canonical path when safe. For anchor renames it will add a TODO comment in the file if it can't determine the correct anchor. Example command I'll run in CI:
```
# run locally for a directory
yarn docs:lint --rules voice,links --fix ./docs/product
```
liz: Heads-up — some marketing-led pages intentionally use lowercase product names for tone. We should exclude /marketing from the auto-fix run or add an allowlist.
morgan: Good catch. I'll add a per-path allowlist in the lint config. Will exclude /marketing and /brand-guidelines by default.
anya: For the migration guide snippets, can we also output a short changelog of replacements so writers can review? Something like: 
- 'redwood' -> 'Redwood' (32 occurrences)
- 'dedicated' -> 'Dedicated' (12 occurrences)
That would make PR reviews much faster.
morgan: Yep — the linter will generate a plain text report artifact and a JSON machine-readable file for the console. I'll attach the report to the PR.
sam: Who wants to review the PR? I can help with link validation and smoke-check re-run in the render pipeline.
liz: I'll do copy reviews for product pages (tone and naming). @morgan, please tag me on product-area changes.
morgan: Thanks. Plan: 1) run lint with --fix on a small subset (/docs/product and /docs/sdk) 2) open a single automated PR with grouped commits (voice fixes vs link fixes) 3) attach the replacement report and a short human summary 4) request @liz + @sam reviews. If anything looks risky we can run a canary deploy to staging docs.
anya: Small ask: please keep sentences that mention customers untouched unless we have explicit phrasing in the style guide — I hit a false positive last time where an example quote got reformatted.
morgan: Will add a heuristic to skip blockquotes and code blocks. Also will not modify text inside example JSON/YAML.
dev-docs-bot: CI check queued: docs-lint-run (voice+links). Estimated duration: ~2m.
morgan: I'll open the PR in about 10 minutes and drop the link here. If anyone wants to opt a page in/out, reply here with the path.
sam: Adding /docs/integrations/google-cloud to the opt-out list — we have a partner-approved phrase set in that page.
liz: Also opt out /docs/partner-templates.
morgan: Got it: excluded paths updated. Thanks — I'll proceed and post PR link shortly.
anya: Awesome — thanks for doing this, Morgan. These automated fixes will cut down on review churn. :thumbsup:
morgan: PR posted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 — contains 78 voice fixes and 23 link updates. Tagging reviews: @liz @sam @anya
sam: Quick scan looks ok. I'll run the staging render and report back if anything breaks.
liz: Reviewing now, will comment on a few marketing-adjacent phrases that slipped in despite allowlist.
morgan: Noted — will revert those few lines in the PR. Thanks team.
